# **How Swipe helped us modernise our CA practice**


I am **Pradyumna Teja K** ., and I speak on behalf of Murthy & Kanth, a chartered-accountancy practice founded in 1984. Since then, we have witnessed finance and compliance evolve in ways we could not have imagined. Yet one fact stands out more than any other today:


## **Automation is no longer optional**


Nowadays, things move fast, and I really think that automating day-to-day tasks with a good **digital billing platform** is a must for any modern office. With that idea in mind, we began hunting for a tool that would trim paperwork, tidy up billing, and speed up our workflow- and that's exactly when **Swipe** caught our eye.


After several months of regular use, I can honestly say Swipe has made our team quicker, calmer, and much more organised, a change every CA firm should welcome.


## **What impressed us most about Swipe**


As a firm handling high volumes of client data, tax filings, and documentation, our biggest hurdles were time, accuracy, and integration. Here’s what changed for us:


- **Automation of tasks** that earlier took hours is now done in minutes


- **Smooth GST return integration** that used to be tedious and error-prone


- **All-in-one platform** that covers billing, client records, and GST workflows


- Minimal training required since the interface is simple and intuitive


As a **CA** , I can confidently say this: Swipe isn’t just **accounting software** . It’s a **tailor-made automated billing software for real-world accounting needs** especially when it comes to **GST compliance** , **client tracking** , and **day-to-day operations** .


## **Why we trust Swipe**


From a CA firm’s point of view, software can either slow you down or become your biggest enabler. **Swipe** falls into the second category. It’s not bloated. It’s not confusing. It just works and that’s what makes it the **best billing software in India** for firms like ours.


Today, we don’t worry about missed payments, scattered data, or slow billing cycles.


We've set our accounting tasks on automation, cut way down on human goofs, and earned extra hours to build stronger ties with clients.


## **A note to fellow CAs and business owners**


"Don’t wait. Automate. A software like Swipe isn't just about saving time, it is about building a smarter, more agile business."


Whether you run a decades-old CA firm or are launching your first practice, one truth keeps popping up- **manual billing** is slowing you down. When your tools can't keep pace with your dreams, it's better to jump to digital billing now.


## **Final thoughts**


My experience with Swipe taught me something clear: even companies with thirty years behind them must keep changing. Once we moved to Swipe's **billing automation** , we didn't only go paperless- we got leaner, quicker, and better prepared for tomorrow's challenges.


So, if you are still wading through printed invoices, flipping between a dozen apps, or burning midnight oil to correct GST mistakes, take the leap and make life easier.


[Try Swipe today](https://getswipe.in/) and transform your business, one bill at a time.
